chapters.title: Welcome, Amethyst
chapters.text: Hello, Amethyst. I am so excited to walk you through your profile. Since it's almost November, you took this assessment back in June, and there's a really good chance many things have changed, because I'm sure you're very highly self-aware, you know your situation, and you help people with their issues. If you disagree with some of it, it's because you may have changed quite a bit since you first took this assessment.

chapters.title: DISC · Dominance and Influence
chapters.text: DISC profile has to do with how you do what you do. There are two graphs, natural and adapted. Natural is how you would behave at home with people around you, and adapted is how you may modify your behavior in the workplace. You have zero to 100 for each graph, and there are four different distinct colors. The first one is dominance, and that has to do with decisiveness, being aggressive, assertiveness, being task-oriented, wanting to do things very quickly, and jumping into activity. Most people with high dominance are very confrontational. They enjoy a good banter back and forth with people. Since you are low dominant at seven and seven for both, you're very peace-oriented. You don't like to confront. You don't jump into things. You're very circumspect. On the challenging side, you may bottle up a lot of your stress for a long time. It would be almost like a 5.0 or 6.0 earthquake. The emotion behind dominance is being frustrated or angry. It doesn't mean you don't get frustrated or angry. It just means you probably don't show it as much. The next one, which is your core behavior, is influencing. You're at 94 and 92. You are all about people. This deals with people and context. The emotion is optimism, which means most of the time, you would see things from an optimistic perspective. You can be very creative, and your claim to fame, your number one attribute could be that you can articulate feelings, emotions, everything into verbal tasks. You enjoy being with people that you really love, that you want to help. You could get sidetracked with being a bit too wordy at times. Maybe you're very powerful when it comes to understanding people, and it's very high empathy.

chapters.title: DISC · Steadiness and Compliance
chapters.text: The next one is steady. This deals with pace and consistency. You're at 90 or 84, which means your pace is slow, but you're extremely reliable. You could be like the pillar upon which people can build. I would say having the I and the S together like this makes you someone who is very compassionate, very caring, with high empathy. You also don't always display your emotions with the high S. When we look at your compliance, which is the blue bar, at home is 28, at work becomes 8, which is a significant drop. C stands for compliance, following rules, regulations, being analytical, detail oriented, always seeking perfection. The emotion behind it is at a high level, it's fear or cautiousness. Your C is low, which means you like the rules you like and you don't like the rules you don't like. It means you have no fear, in particular regarding people. It actually makes you very bold, someone who's willing to take chances in understanding others and helping others. You're always trying to find something different, a new way of looking at things. This makes you what's called a promoting relator. There's not much significant changes from natural to adapted. Relators are people who want to be a bridge between all other behavioral patterns. You could really promote what you believe in. You're very steadfast and you go almost all out with it. As long as it's helping people, then you're all in.

chapters.title: Driving Forces · Knowledge, Utility, Surroundings
chapters.text: When it comes to why you do the things you do, we look at your intellectuals at 61%, instinctives at 24. That means you prefer to read and study over trusting your instincts. The other one is utility. You're right in the center, 35 resourceful, 38 selfless. 35 means you're someone who enjoys return on investment of time, money, and energy, but you also don't mind using your time, money, and energy for the sake of other people. You're both family and team oriented. Under surrounding, there's a huge imbalance between being objective or harmonious. Objective means these are people who are motivated by how things function. You prefer how things feel. You want to have a beautiful environment. You want to have a nice appearance. You want to bring harmony to people. You enjoy really a great deal of extending and receiving love and care to people and from people. That's your number two, harmonious, very high.

chapters.title: Driving Forces · Others, Power, Methodologies
chapters.text: When it comes to others, your intentional is 39, your altruistic is 46. Almost balanced, but you prefer to help people. You don't mind catching the fish, filleting them, and cooking them and putting in front of people. Performance is also important to you. Strategy and purpose is important. When it comes to power, people either want to give power or you want to take power. You're more collaborative than commanding, which means you want to create a consensus for people. You ask people's opinion before you do it. As far as methodologies, you're not a traditionalist. You don't like anything structured. That's your number one driver is receptive, which means you're a change agent. You are someone who's motivated by innovation, creativity, bringing things into people's perspective, and you're very powerful when it comes to mixing that with reading, being intellectual, also creating harmony with what you bring in. You're someone who's very compassionate, and it shows both in your behavior and it also shows in your drivers. When it comes to your soft skills, your number one most advanced soft skill is understanding others, negotiation flexibility and conflict management, creativity and innovation, employee development coaching, appreciating others, interpersonal skills.

chapters.title: Acumen · Clarity and perspective
chapters.text: Acumen has to do with your clarity of how you see yourself and you see the world around you. When it comes to external clarity of awareness, performance and situation, you have decent clarity and there's not a whole lot of bias distortion. However, when it comes to internal clarity of performance, you have clarity for both. You're balanced, you're realistic regarding yourself. However, you have an emotional bias distortion of 45. Judgment: personal feelings and assumptions may influence conclusions, objectivity, difficulty separating facts from emotional interpretations, awareness, potential blind spots when evaluating people, tasks and systems, decision making, greater risk of overlooking important information and alternative perspectives. A score of 45 does not mean person is emotionally unstable or lack intelligence or consistently making poor decisions. Let's take a look at your attitude index. Your attitude index is outstanding. You're looking at approving, favorable, dynamic, lively, energetic, vibrant, appreciative, grateful, thankful, positive, encouraging, upbeat, open-minded, accessible, flexible.

chapters.title: Acumen · World View
chapters.text: When it comes to your dimensional balance, you have a very high level of understanding others at 92%. You can go anywhere, deal with anybody, and you're also non-biased towards people. Your tasks, which is practical thinking, you have very high clarity, but you have a very strong bias distortion, which you don't really like mundane things. You like exciting things. When it comes to systems judgment, you're very high at 80, and you have an up arrow, which means you enjoy new strategies. And particular, because when I overlay this with your drivers, is when it comes to helping people, you really enjoy creating new ways of creating systems for that.

chapters.title: Acumen · Self View and closing
chapters.text: The self-view, your sense of self is a bit low at 56, and I'm pretty sure that right now it may have gone up quite a bit, but back in June, you weren't quite sure of yourself. You needed some time to recover, perhaps from a long-term impact of a bad relationship. Your role awareness, you're at 60, which means there's a little bit of lack of clarity, but you have an up arrow, which means you're looking forward to new roles. You're creating new roles for yourself. What no longer serves you, no longer makes you happy, and you're trying to find new ways to, again, the bottom line for you is helping and being altruistic. At the time when you took this, your self-direction was a bit low at 48%, but you had an up arrow, which meant, okay, I'm going through some changes. I don't know exactly what the future holds, but I know it's going to be great. At the time when you took this assessment, it looks like you were going through a transitional period. The more you stay true to your emotions, the more you stay true to your core desire, which is helping people, coming up with alternative ways to extend your love and care and compassion to people, the happier you're going to be. So I hope this helps. I know this is a long profile, but we try to condense it into 15 minutes. If you have any questions, please let me know. Thank you so much for your time, and I look forward to talking to you some more. Bye-bye.
